subject: Archer onboarding: temporary credentials, presign ingest & SOC 2 evidence plan
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@archer-sec.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@archer-sec.com>, vendors@archer-sec.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal onboarding – presign ingest & SOC 2 artifact delivery

Hi Michael,

Thanks for agreeing to support Archer's vendor portal onboarding. We're starting the profile and evidence ingestion phase and have two asks to avoid manual uploads:

1) Temporary credentials / presign window for automated evidence ingest (SOC 2 reports, CAIQ fragments, SIG answers). We prefer presign URLs to avoid shared SFTP accounts.
2) A short onboarding checklist we can follow so our security team can map the artifacts to Archer's requirements without repeated back-and-forth.

I've attached a presign manifest template and a zip of our current SOC 2 certs for initial mapping. Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood prefers S3 presign upload or SFTP for this portal?
- Minimum TTL you'd accept for presigned PUTs for vendor ingestion?

We're aiming to complete the first ingest by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-03).

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Chen
Vendor Security Program Manager
Archer Inc.

Attachments: archer_presign_manifest.csv, soc2_certificates_bundle.pdf

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@archer-sec.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding – presign ingest & SOC 2 artifact delivery

Olivia — thanks for the manifest and bundle. Quick checklist below to keep us on the same page and unblock the ingest: 

Action items for Archer (owner: Archer security):
- Confirm whether you'll use Archer's portal direct presign (preferred) or provide SFTP credentials by 11/02 EOD.
- Populate manifest with file paths + sha256 (you already started, thank you).
- Flag any encrypted artifacts that need KMS-wrapped keys.

Action items for Redwood (owner: Michael):
- We will accept S3 presign PUTs to our temporary ingestion bucket. Presign TTL: recommend 24h max; we can extend to 72h for large transfers but need explicit exceptions.
- Provide a short presign instructions doc and a sample presign endpoint. See attached presign_instructions_v1.md.
- Map CAIQ fields to our internal CAIQ -> RedTeam mapping; Rishi will do the first pass.

Questions:
- Do you require vendor-side encryption before upload? (If so, share the key wrapping steps.)
- Any regulatory constraints on artifact residency (e.g., EU-only storage)?

If you confirm presign flow, we can issue a tenant-specific presign token and a 48h TTL for your first ingest.

I'll loop in Laura to coordinate the manifest ingestion and KMS notes.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Sr. Security Partner Engineer | Redwood Inference

--

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@archer-sec.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@archer-sec.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding – presign ingest & SOC 2 artifact delivery

Thanks, Michael — we can confirm the presign flow is preferred. A couple of clarifications:

- Archer will upload artifacts from our CI job that can call presign PUTs. We do not plan to do vendor-side encryption; we will rely on TLS + your KMS at rest.
- Residency: all artifacts must remain in the US for this customer.

I've attached the completed manifest (archer_presign_manifest.csv) with SHA256 and sizes filled in. The SOC 2 bundle includes two PDF certs and an auditor letter.

Also included one internal contact (samir.patel@archer-sec.com) who will run the CI job and ownership for uploads.

Attached: archer_presign_manifest.csv, soc2_certificates_bundle.pdf

Olivia

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@archer-sec.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding – presign ingest & SOC 2 artifact delivery

Hi Olivia — looping in specifics for the ingestion pipeline and KMS handling.

Notes / constraints from ops:
- We will generate tenant-scoped presign tokens tied to a short-lived IAM role. Right now the standard TTL is 24h; we can extend to 48h for this initial bulk. Please request the 48h exception in reply.
- Upload target: s3://redwood-ingest-us-east-1/archer/<tenant-id>/incoming/ — your manifest should reference those relative keys.
- If artifacts are sensitive (audit reports), we mark them with tag:security=high which triggers tighter retention and audit logging.
- KMS: we always encrypt server-side with our AWS KMS key (arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:XXXXXXXX:key/abcd-ef01). If you need to provide your own wrapped key, let us know — ops will coordinate a wrap/unwrap exchange.

Deliverables we'll provide once you confirm presign:
1) presign endpoint and sample curl requests (presign_instructions_v1.md attached).
2) a short runbook we ask you to follow for manifest formatting (I added two sample rows).
3) a temporary IAM role binding that Samir's CI can assume.

If Archer confirms the 48h TTL and US-only residency, ops will issue the presign credentials by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Technical Program Manager, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: presign_instructions_v1.md

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@archer-sec.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding – presign ingest & SOC 2 artifact delivery

Thanks everyone. Quick note from CAIQ/SIG mapping side: 

- I'll run the manifest against our CAIQ mapping script and return a CSV mapping (our fields -> Archer portal questions) by EOD 11/03. That will include suggested fragment IDs for the vendor portal so Archer can claim answers automatically.
- Request: please include a sample answered CAIQ fragment (even a partial JSON or CSV) if you have one in the manifest. It speeds up the mapping.
- I will also check the SOC 2 PDFs for attestations that map to SIG controls; expect a short findings matrix.

If Archer confirms the 48h TTL and US-only restriction in reply, ops will cut the presign token and I will start the mapping run.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Applied ML — Inference Ops
Redwood Inference
